rationale: A duration prior needs more than (agency, task). A step's elapsed time decomposes into TOUCH time (someone working) and QUEUE time (waiting for someone to start), and those obey different laws: touch time scales with task type and artifact complexity; queue time scales with backlog, batching cadence, and who is holding the ball. Two steps with the same (agency, task) but different cadence (a daily cashiering batch vs a monthly council hearing) have incomparable durations. So the unit is a 6-tuple.

agency_class.front_counter: permit center, intake window, records counter — receives and screens
agency_class.plan_review: technical review of submitted documents (building, planning, environmental health plan check)
agency_class.field_inspection: an inspector physically visiting or examining
agency_class.background_check: a records/eligibility check against databases (DOJ, FBI, IEVS, state registry)
agency_class.caseworker: an assigned individual adjudicating an application with interviews (benefits, licensing)
agency_class.specialist_referral: a second department consulted (fire, health, assessor, utility, county)
agency_class.utility: an investor-owned or municipal utility acting outside the agency (interconnection, PTO)
agency_class.third_party: a licensed private actor the rule relies on (contractor inspection, certifier, commissary)
agency_class.legislative_body: council, board, commission acting on a cycle
agency_class.hearing_officer: an adjudicator of appeals or fines
agency_class.state_agency: a state-level licensing or benefits agency acting on its own clock

task_type.intake_screen: completeness / eligibility screening of a submittal
task_type.document_review: substantive review of plans or evidence
task_type.records_check: query of databases or files about a person or parcel
task_type.interview: a scheduled conversation to establish facts
task_type.test_or_exam: an examination the applicant must pass
task_type.notice: producing and sending a required communication
task_type.scheduling: assigning an appointment or queue slot
task_type.appeal: review of a decision by another body
task_type.referral: routing a case to another actor and awaiting return

blocking_party.agency: the clock runs on the agency; the applicant is waiting
blocking_party.applicant: the clock runs on the applicant (gather documents, schedule, correct)
blocking_party.third_party: a contractor, utility, or certifier holds the ball
blocking_party.shared: both must act (e.g. an interview requires both to appear)

cadence.daily_batch: processed in a daily cycle (cashiering, overnight batch)
cadence.biweekly_or_monthly_cycle: a scheduled body (council, board, hearing calendar)
cadence.on_request: happens only when the applicant asks
cadence.statutory_clock: duration fixed or capped by law rather than by work

duration_fields.touch_days: working time once started (often hours; record as fractional days)
duration_fields.elapsed_days: queue + touch, what an applicant experiences
duration_fields.p50_p90: report median and p90 where n permits

evidence_tier.verifiable_official: an agency's own published statistic, dataset, or audited figure
evidence_tier.designed_document: a staff report, SOP, manual, or consultant study stating an intended duration
evidence_tier.statutory: a clock written into law (a ceiling, not a measurement)
evidence_tier.community_reported: user reports (reddit, forums) — colloquial, selection-biased toward delay
evidence_tier.inferred: computed by us from records (e.g. permit-log timestamps)

observation_schema.step_label: what the step is called locally
observation_schema.n: number of cases behind the number (1 for a single user report)
observation_schema.source_id: sources.json source_id or gold document id
observation_schema.date: YYYY-MM-DD of the observation or document
observation_schema.notes: caveats: selection bias, stale, disputed by another source

agency_level.local: a city, county or district body
agency_level.private: a licensed contractor, utility or other non-government actor

agency_role.adjudication: decides a case, usually with an interview
agency_role.third_party: a private actor the rule relies on
agency_role.unspecified: the source names an organisational level but no function

note_v2: agency_class mixed organisational level with functional role (state_agency names a level, plan_review names a role). Level and role are now separate dimensions; agency_class is kept for continuity and agency_class_split maps it onto the two.
